instruction: Open Krita from the Applications grid, create a new 800x600 px image, make any visible mark on the canvas, then save the document as "krita_task.kra" and export a PNG copy as "krita_task.png" to the Pictures folder.

verification.condition: Verify that the files ~/Pictures/krita_task.kra and ~/Pictures/krita_task.png exist and that krita_task.png has image dimensions of 800x600 pixels.
verification.expected_result: Both files are present in the Pictures folder, and krita_task.png reports a resolution of exactly 800x600 pixels.
